summary: Practise impartial interviews, evidence assessment, and defensible reporting in advanced workplace investigations training. Review the course outline.
lede: Workplace investigations are structured inquiries that assess reported conduct or policy concerns and document supportable findings. For HR investigators, employee-relations leads, compliance investigators, and legal or safeguarding professionals, this advanced training practises complaint triage, impartial interview planning, evidence logging and assessment, findings analysis, and report drafting through case simulations. Exercises address safeguarding, confidentiality, evidence traceability, and procedural fairness.
audienceIntro: This advanced practicum is designed for professionals who already handle workplace concerns and need to strengthen the quality and defensibility of investigation work.
prerequisites: Prior experience handling workplace complaints, employee-relations matters, compliance inquiries, safeguarding concerns, or comparable casework is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s investigation policies where available; exercises use simulated case materials.
